quirks.description: The iOS version of a native app's `iOS/18.1` token stops at the first dot: appleVersion() reads `[0-9_]+` after a bare `OS`, so the version is `18`
The console rule accepts `WiiU` but not `Wii U` (the operating-system rule accepts both), so `Nintendo Wii U` is the model `Nintendo Wii`
quirks.case: edge.json#Nintendo Wii U OS rule and device rule differ

quirks.description: The brand rules run on `<model> <user agent>`, so a rule can match across the join: the model `Mi` followed by ` Mozilla` matches Xiaomi's `\bMi [A-Z0-9]`
quirks.case: edge.json#Mi brand crosses into the user agent
